name: upscale-4k-hdr-png
description: Below-4K illustration -> 4K: one Real-CUGAN pass (2x or 4x, --set per source), capped at 3840 on the long edge with the aspect ratio preserved, written out twice: a 4K SDR PNG and, after the semantic HDR chain, a scRGB JPEG XR.

stages.note: path comes from `imgen run -i FILE` unless params.path is set
on the source, before the SR pass: JPEG-sourced gradients are the ones the model would otherwise bake in

stages.label: sr
stages.note: pick the scale so the result clears the 3840 target and then gets reduced: 2x when 2x(long edge) >= 3840, else 4x (models-se, which is where up4x-no-denoise lives)
cap at 4K; portraits stay portraits, only the long edge is fixed
the SDR deliverable: the restored 4K image with no HDR grade applied
LumiPic; cached as .npy, so the hdr.map knee/rolloff below can be re-tuned without the GPU
knee/rolloff are provisional defaults: read the .npy distribution first (see docs/HDR-NOTES.md) — a knee copied from another image's grade is the easiest way to get a flat HDR
